title: Quasilinear Schrödinger Critical Problem on the Heisenberg group \(\mathbb{H}^N\)
summary: We study the existence of standing wave solutions for the following quasilinear Schrödinger equations with critical growth on the Heisenberg group $$ -Δ_{\mathbb{H}} u +V(ξ)u-Δ_{\mathbb{H}} (\left|u\right|^{2α})\left|u\right|^{2α-2} u= λ\left|u\right|^{q-2}u + \left|u\right|^{p-2}u \text{ in }\mathbb{H}^N $$ where $\mathbb{H}^N$ is Heisenberg group, $Δ_{\mathbb{H}}$ is Kohn Laplacian operator, $4α \frac{1}{2}.$ By a suitable nonlinear change of variables, the quasilinear equation is transformed into a semilinear one, allowing the use of variational methods in the Folland--Stein Sobolev space…
